name: Steam access
author: Rigbay contributors
description: Restores access to Steam on networks that block it, through a local proxy, DNS over HTTPS and a PAC file.

network: listens on 127.0.0.1:18081 (local proxy and PAC file, loopback only)
listens on 127.0.0.1:80 (Steam's game downloader, loopback only)
DNS over HTTPS to 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8, cloudflare-dns.com and dns.google, for Steam host names only
outgoing connections to the real Steam servers
registry: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings\AutoConfigURL (the proxy script address of the current user: set while the bypass is on, the previous value put back when it is off)
